## Why This Is Asked
Design a cost-aware routing layer for multi-tenant Azure OpenAI deployments.

## Key Concepts
- Dynamic model routing with per-tenant budgets
- Telemetry and drift monitoring
- Data residency, caching, and fallback mechanisms

## Code Example
```javascript
function chooseDeployment(features, budget){
  if (budget.remaining < 0.5) return 'gpt-3.5';
  if (features.hasCode) return 'gpt-4';
  return 'gpt-4o';
}
```

- How would you handle model drift and per-tenant policy updates?
